rule: COMPANY → PRODUCT → CONFIGURATION → HARDWARE → CAPABILITIES. Never company → category.
notes: Evidence-backed named SKUs only. Empty specs stay UNKNOWN. Not Job Card employers.
These OEMs ship mixed morphology: humanoid AND serving AND cleaning AND/OR quadruped.
Live page extract still wins when it contradicts this cache.
PUDU D9 official page: full-sized bipedal humanoid. BellaBot/CC1 already have workbook tasks.
Keenon C55/C40/C20 named as floor cleaners on the KLEENBOT C55 page; T11 is DINERBOT catering delivery.
UBTECH Walker official page: Humanoid Service Robot, bipedal walking.
Deep Robotics homepage is quadruped; DR02 page is industrial humanoid; X20/X30 are official quadruped pages.
MagicLab /en/x1 MagicBot X1 humanoid; /en/dog MagicDog quadruped. Do not invent SKUs without a page.
AgiBot homepage names G1 and X2 as embodied/humanoid. Do not invent A3 Ultra here — index already has it.
2026-08-31 cleaning + mixed F&B operator list: named SKUs from live pages only.
Lucidbots Sherpa is a cleaning drone, not a floor scrubber.
Kaercher: robotic KIRA line only — not mop/pressure-washer SKUs.
Tennant robotics hub names X6 ROVR and X16 SWEEP; T7AMR / T380AMR / T16AMR product pages name those SKUs. Not AMR scrubbers.
Richtech homepage 429 (Vercel checkpoint) — reclass existing ADAM/Scotty only.
SEER lifting/forklift/controller pages name AMB / SFL / SCB / SRC SKUs. Not Seer Humanoid.
VinMotion homepage Product menu names Motion 1 and Motion 2. Motion 1 is a humanoid robot on the homepage. Motion 2 launching page is thin — no invented class.
Live page extract still wins. Empty specs stay UNKNOWN. Not Job Card employers.
